title: Deliver a localized offline job handover
goal: Transfer locale, encoding, time and one-off execution decisions without repeating a guided repair.
challenge: Independently deliver exact factual results from a different dataset, a successful bounded job and a readable handover. Retain actual IDs, owners, statuses, contents and failed evidence. Never fixed job numbers or broad cancellation; completion remains self-reviewed.

steps.command: w=$(mktemp -d "$HOME/foundation-localization-handover.XXXXXX") && cd "$w" && umask 077; here() { case "$w" in "$HOME"/foundation-localization-handover.??????) ;; *) return 19;; esac; test "${w%/*}" = "$HOME" && test -d "$w" && test ! -L "$w" && test "$(realpath -e "$w")" = "$w" && test "$(pwd -P)" = "$w" && test "$(stat -c %U:%a "$w")" = learner:700; }; fresh() { here && test "${1%/*}" = "$w" && test ! -e "$1" && test ! -L "$1"; }; regular() { here && test "${1%/*}" = "$w" && test -f "$1" && test ! -L "$1" && test "$(stat -c %U:%a:%h "$1")" = learner:600:1; }; jobid() { regular "$1" || return 19; job=$(awk '$1=="job" && $2 ~ /^[0-9]+$/ {print $2}' "$1"); case "$job" in ''|*[!0-9]*) return 19;; *) test "$job" -gt 0;; esac; }; here && test "$(df -B1 --output=avail / | tail -1)" -ge 1073741824 && systemctl is-active atd && pwd
steps.explanation: Record the private path/definitions. Refuse collisions and insufficient space; Resume reuses the recorded workspace, not a new job.
steps.expected: Owned700 workspace, actual atd and observed1GiB reserve.

steps.command:
here && fresh "$w/incident.txt" && printf "Source bytes: ISO-8859-1 cafe-with-e-acute plus newline.
Instant: 2026-07-01 12:00:00 UTC.
Required report: UTF-8, UTC instant and Berlin offset; capture C-locale job.
Wrong handover calls the source UTF-8 and assumes Berlin is always +0100.
" > incident.txt && fresh "$w/source-latin1.txt" && printf "caf\351
" > source-latin1.txt && fresh "$w/source.sha" && sha256sum source-latin1.txt > source.sha && cat incident.txt
steps.explanation: Use this tiny different dataset and deliberately misleading report. Facts have independent byte/time expectations; language/causal reasoning remains self-reviewed.
steps.expected: Original incident and encoding evidence retained.

steps.command: foundation_step() { here && fresh "$w/wrong-partial.txt" && fresh "$w/wrong-error.txt" || return 19; if timeout -k 1s 10s iconv -f UTF-8 -t UTF-8 source-latin1.txt > wrong-partial.txt 2> wrong-error.txt; then return 1; else test $? = 1 && test -s wrong-error.txt && sha256sum -c source.sha; fi; }; foundation_step
steps.explanation: Retain a wrong encoding hypothesis and partial output; failure does not authorize discarding the original.
steps.expected: Actual strict rejection and original preserved.

steps.command: here && fresh "$w/recovered-utf8.txt" && fresh "$w/expected-utf8.txt" && timeout -k 1s 10s iconv -f ISO-8859-1 -t UTF-8 source-latin1.txt > recovered-utf8.txt && printf "caf\303\251\n" > expected-utf8.txt && cmp recovered-utf8.txt expected-utf8.txt && fresh "$w/zone.txt" && env TZ=Europe/Berlin LC_ALL=C date -d "2026-07-01 12:00:00 UTC" "+%F %T %z" > zone.txt && grep -Fx "2026-07-01 14:00:00 +0200" zone.txt && sha256sum -c source.sha
steps.explanation: Recover exact UTF-8 and resolve the fixed instant without guest default/clock changes. Do not present a handover sentence or keyword as automated reasoning assessment.
steps.expected: Independent recovered bytes and actual summer offset.

steps.command:
here && fresh "$w/job.sh" && cat > job.sh <<'LL_JOB'
#!/bin/sh
umask 077 || exit 90
ulimit -f 8 || exit 91
test ! -e result && test ! -L result || exit 89
set -C || exit 92
{
 /usr/bin/awk '/^Max file size/ {print "file_limit_soft=" $4 " hard=" $5}' /proc/self/limits
 /usr/bin/timeout --kill-after=2s 6s /bin/sh -c 'printf "identity=%s\nuid=%s\ncwd=%s\numask=%s\n" "$(id -un)" "$(id -u)" "$(pwd -P)" "$(umask)"; printf "LANG=%s\nLC_ALL=%s\n" "$LANG" "$LC_ALL"; test "$LANG" = C && test "$LC_ALL" = C && printf "bounded-job-complete\n"'
 rc=$?
 printf 'exit=%s\n' "$rc"
} > result 2>&1
exit "$rc"
LL_JOB
steps.explanation: Prepare the same bounded result contract, then choose explicit scheduling context for the independent handover.
steps.expected: Finite /bin/sh job; no reliance on interactive shell functions.

steps.command: here && fresh "$w/result" && regular "$w/job.sh" && fresh "$w/queued.log" && env LANG=C LC_ALL=C /usr/bin/at -M -f "$w/job.sh" now + 1 minute > queued.log 2>&1 && jobid "$w/queued.log" && printf "Recorded job=%s workspace=%s\n" "$job" "$w"
steps.explanation: Queue only this owned job; retain its ID/body/context.

steps.command: foundation_step() { here && jobid "$w/queued.log" || return 19; deadline=$(( $(date +%s)+150 )); while ! grep -Fxq exit=0 "$w/result" 2>/dev/null; do test "$(date +%s)" -lt "$deadline" || return 19; sleep 1; done; regular "$w/result" && test "$(wc -c < result)" -le 4096 && grep -Fx identity=learner result && grep -Fx "uid=$(id -u)" result && grep -Fx "cwd=$w" result && grep -Fx umask=0077 result && grep -Fx LANG=C result && grep -Fx LC_ALL=C result && grep -Fx "file_limit_soft=4096 hard=4096" result && grep -Fx bounded-job-complete result || return 19; while :; do fresh "$w/queue-current.txt" || regular "$w/queue-current.txt" || return 19; atq > queue-current.txt || return 19; if awk -v id="$job" '$1==id {f=1} END {exit !f}' queue-current.txt; then test "$(date +%s)" -lt "$deadline" || return 19; sleep 1; else break; fi; done; cat result; }; foundation_step
steps.explanation: Verify actual execution evidence before writing the handover: encoding/zone facts and successful job are separate claims.
steps.expected: Known output, real identity/cwd/locale/status and no pending owned job.

hints: No causal or language-quality score from keywords; correct-looking display alone does not prove correct encoded bytes or execution.
Use the actual dynamically captured job ID and successful owner-matched queue queries; a command failure is not an empty queue.
Inspect actual result ownership, bytes and exit status; cancel only positively matched pending work before exact rollback.
review: I demonstrated the selected mode’s facts, actual identities/results and an incorrect interpretation or attempt.
I can separate queueing, execution, access policy and self-reviewed reasoning. Completion is unscored and not automatic verification.
I removed only positively matched owned jobs, restored any exact policy fixture and retained evidence; no authentication or host changes.
coverage: LPIC-1 active v5.0 partial 107.3 and108.2 independent transfer; no new objective credit. No full objective, automatic assessment or endorsement. The plan’s 107.2 at tags were corrected to active108.2;107.2 concerns display/X11.
